title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 10: the fathers under the cloud, examples written for admonition, the way of escape, and doing all to the glory of God.

questions.text: According to verses 1 and 2, what did the fathers all pass through?
questions.explanation: The verses say our fathers were all under the cloud and all passed through the sea, and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

questions.text: What does verse 4 say the spiritual rock was?
questions.explanation: The verse says they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

questions.text: What happened to most of the fathers, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: The verse says God was not well pleased with most of them, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

answers.text: They were overthrown in the wilderness
They were scattered among the nations

questions.text: Which words are quoted in verse 7 about the people?
questions.explanation: The verse quotes, "The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play."

answers.text: "The people murmured against Moses in the desert."
"The people gathered the manna every morning."
"The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play."
"The people wept at the door of their tents."

questions.text: How many fell in one day, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: The verse says that in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

questions.text: What does verse 10 say happened to those who grumbled?
questions.explanation: The verse says they perished by the destroyer.

questions.text: According to verse 13, what does God do along with the temptation?
questions.explanation: The verse says God will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

answers.text: He sends an angel to teach
He makes the way of escape

questions.text: Why does verse 17 say that the many are one body?
questions.explanation: The verse says that because there is one loaf of bread, we who are many are one body, for we all partake of the one loaf.

answers.text: Because they all live together in one city
Because there is one loaf of bread, of which all partake
Because they all have one teacher among them
Because they were all baptized by the same man

questions.text: What two things does verse 21 say cannot be done together?
questions.explanation: The verse says you cannot both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons, nor partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

answers.text: Eating meat and giving thanks for it
Praying in the assembly and prophesying
Keeping the feast and fasting at the same time
Drinking the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons

questions.text: According to verse 31, how should they eat, drink and do whatever they do?
questions.explanation: The verse says that whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

answers.text: All in the sight of the assembly
All to the glory of God
All as the law of Moses says
